EXTERNAL CIRCULAR 031 OF 2021
(December 22nd)
Attention:
LEGAL REPRESENTATIVES AND FISCAL REVIEWERS OF ISSUERS
Subject: Instructions regarding the disclosure of information on social and environmental issues, including climate related issues
Dear Sirs,
The Financial Superintendency of Colombia recognizes the efforts being made by issuers in the adoption of standards for the disclosure of sustainability information to different stakeholders, with a focus on environmental and social materiality.
Notwithstanding the foregoing, and with the purpose of standardizing and improving the relevance of sustainability practice information for investors, and strengthening their disclosure by issuers, the Superintendency considers it necessary to issue instructions on the disclosure of information on social and environmental issues, including climate related issues, from a financial materiality perspective, through the adoption of the international standards of the Task Force for Climate Related Financial Disclosure (TCFD) and the Value Reporting Foundation’s (VRF) SASB Standards.
By virtue of the foregoing, this Office, in exercise of the powers conferred in Paragraph a) of Article 6 of Law 964 of 2005, and Articles 5.2.4.1.1, 5.2.4.2.2., 5.2.4.2.3. and Paragraph 4 of Article 11.2.1.4.2 of Decree 2555 of 2010, issues the following instructions:
FIRST: Add Annex 2 "Disclosure of information on social and environmental issues, including climate related issues" to Chapter I, Title V, Part III of the Basic Legal Circular to define the rules applicable to issuers regarding disclosure of information on social and environmental issues, including climate related issues, within the year-end periodic report and the quarterly periodic report.
SECOND: Add Paragraph 3 to Chapter I, Title V, Part III of the Basic Legal Circular "National Registry of Securities and Issuers – RNVE" to adjust the reference to the instructions contained in Annex 2, which is created by this Circular.
THIRD. Transition Regime: Issuers must submit through the RNVE, no later than 2024, in accordance with the deadlines and instructions established in sub-sections 5.5 and 6 of Annex 2 of Chapter I, Title V, Part III of the Basic Legal Circular and the instructions provided for in this Circular, the following information: (i) the draft chapter devoted to practices, policies, processes and indicators in relation to social and environmental issues, including climate related issues, (ii) within the annual report, the chapter devoted to practices, policies, processes and indicators in relation to social and environmental issues, including climate related issues, and (iii) within the quarterly report, the chapter devoted to any material changes that have occurred in the practices, processes, policies and indicators implemented in relation to social and environmental issues, including climate related issues.
As of January 1, 2024, issuers that for the first time are part of the "Group A Issuers" category will have a maximum period of 2 years from the date of change of category, to submit, through the RNVE, in accordance with the terms and instructions provided for in this Circular, the following information: (i) the draft chapter on practices, policies, processes and indicators in relation to social and environmental issues, including climate related issues, (ii) within the annual report, the chapter on practices, policies, processes and indicators in relation to social and environmental issues, including climate related issues, and (iii) within the quarterly report, the chapter devoted to any material changes that have occurred in the practices, processes, policies and indicators implemented in relation to social and environmental issues, including climate related issues.
FOURTH. Implementation Plan: Issuers must submit to this Superintendency no later than February 10, 2023, the Implementation Plan of the instructions contained in this Circular, which must contemplate compliance with all of them by 2024, in accordance with the Transition Regime established in this Circular, without prejudice to those issuers who voluntarily decide to implement the aforementioned instructions before 2024.
This Circular shall apply from the date of its publication.
The corresponding modified pages are appended.
Cordially,
JORGE CASTAÑO GUTIERREZ
Financial Superintendent of Colombia
